Alex W: Hey team — Prospect 'Orchid Health' asked for SOC 2 Type II, ISO artifacts, and a signed pen-test attestation for the POC. They also want a staging environment (SSO or temp API key) and a ballpark Dedicated POC price. Need this by EOD Friday if possible. cc @Grace - Solutions Eng
Grace - Solutions Eng: Thanks Alex. Can you share the prospect security contact + expected POC duration? We can bundle a slim evidence packet (certs + SOC2 summary + checklist). I can draft the pen-test attestation template, but need to know if they're expecting the full report or just the attestation letter.
Ken (Security): Quick policy note: we provide a pen-test attestation letter that states we engaged an external vendor and the date of the test. We do not hand out raw vuln scan or full pen-test reports without an NDA/contract. If Orchid needs the full report, legal will require a data sharing addendum. For the attestation we need the assessor name (if they insist) and 48 hours to prepare. Also: we can upload artifacts to a secure share.
Priya R: For staging creds we can: 1) create a time-limited SAML test account, or 2) issue a scoped API key with TTL. Which does the customer prefer? Note that API keys are limited to non-prod models and have rate limits.
Jamal S: If Orchid wants VPC/private options for the POC we should flag that now (adds lead time). Also want to confirm data retention & log access expectations so we can set env accordingly. For Dedicated trial pricing — we usually offer a 2-week eval at a reduced hourly commit; I can pull the exact quote if you want.
Alex W: Prospect contact is claire@orchidhealth.com, POC = 2 weeks. They prefer SSO but will accept an API key if faster. Please prioritize the attestation letter + a link to the SOC2/ISO bundle.
Ken (Security): I'll draft the attestation. We'll include: scope statement, test date (last external pentest: 2025-11-12), and statement that full report is available under NDA. I'll also put the SOC2 type II cover letter and ISO27001 cert in the share.
Grace - Solutions Eng: Uploading the slim evidence bundle to a secure folder now. Link: https://redwood-secure-shares/ark/orchid-poc (internal placeholder, will swap to expiring share). Also attaching a sample pen-test attestation template for review.
Priya R: For quick provisioning, use this command to create a temp API key (ops will rotate after 72h):
```
create-temp-api-key --user "orchid-claire" --ttl 72h --scope poc-read-only
```
Alex W: Perfect. Ken — can you have the attestation ready by Thu morning? Grace — can you confirm the share is expiring in 7 days?
Ken (Security): Yep, aiming Thu AM.
Grace - Solutions Eng: Confirmed — expiring in 7 days, download disabled. Also added a short readme listing included artifacts.
Alex W: Thanks all. I'll update Claire and request signature on the NDA if Orchid asks for the full report.
audit-bot: Reminder: create ticket INF-2342 to track pen-test attestation delivery and evidence share.
